title: Sequencing: audit workstream
bodyMd:
Five workstreams are audited sequentially, one per numbered period.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Assets, Costs, Inventory, Payroll, Sales.

- Inventory must occur after Assets and before Sales.
- Costs and Payroll must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.
- Sales must not be in position 5.
